verdict.rationale: Browser Use is an open-source Python library that developers can run locally, connecting to a locally-launched Chromium via CDP (browser-use-docs-2) or to their real Chrome profile with saved logins (browser-use-comm-5), and the MCP server/CLI installs keylessly from PyPI via uvx with no cloud account required (browser-use-probe-rt-2). GitHub docs also confirm running automation 'from your own code, and with any LLM' (browser-use-gh-3). missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly walking through a fully local end-to-end dev workflow (vs cloud-focused docs dominating the pack), and independent hands-on confirmation beyond one community comment; also community evidence raises a real security caveat (unauthenticated CDP port) that tempers a perfect score.
